body:
Failure to deposit tax deducted at source or submit quarterly returns triggers daily financial penalties.

Statutory Penalty Provisions:
1. Section 234E: Daily late fee of ₹200 for each day of filing default (capped at the total deduction amount).
2. Section 201(1A): Penal interest @ 1.5% per month for non-deposit of collected TDS.
3. Section 271H: Substantial penalty ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹1,00,000 for prolonged defaults.

Quarterly filing cutoffs (July 31, October 31, January 31, May 31) require disciplined deduction ledger maintenance.
title: Withholding Tax Defaults: Mitigating Section 234E Fees and Section 271H Penalties
summary: Handling quarterly e-TDS returns (24Q, 26Q), TRACES defaults, and correcting PAN unallocated vouchers.
